name: Co-electrolysis of CO2 and water
principle: A solid oxide cell electrolyses steam and CO2 together at high temperature to give syngas (H2 plus CO) directly, which feeds Fischer-Tropsch or methanol synthesis. IEA rates CO2 and H2O co-electrolysis at TRL 6, above the register's lab label.

suppliers.name: Sunfire
suppliers.product: SOEC (raised EUR 215 million in 2024 per IEA text)

source.note: IEA ETP Clean Energy Technology Guide, dataset of 24 July 2026, latest assessment (IEA 1-11 scale): 'CO2 and h2o co-electrolysis' 6 (2025)

advantages: High electrical efficiency in principle (not quantified in sources read)
limitations: Stack durability and scale-up not covered by sources read
